title.zh: 查询截图回调鉴权配置

descriptions.zh:
您已完成配置截图回调鉴权，配置接口请参见[设置截图回调鉴权配置](~~2847907~~)。
本接口支持查询主播流域名已配置的截图回调鉴权信息，调用时请保证参数设置符合要求。
## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为30次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
You can call this operation to query the authentication configuration for snapshot callbacks for a streaming domain. Before you call this operation, you must configure authentication. For more information, see [Set snapshot callback authentication](~~2847907~~).

## QPS limit

This operation is limited to 30 queries per second (QPS) per user. If you exceed this limit, throttling is triggered, which can affect your services.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live query-snapshot-callback-auth --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.aliyundoc.com --region cn-hangzhou
